summary: STRATS Trust for Dominion Resources Series 2005-6 filed a routine Form 8-K reporting that a scheduled distribution was made to certificate holders on September 15, 2026, with the trustee's distribution statement attached as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation transaction occurred; the filing explicitly states no other reportable transactions or matters arose in the period. The trust, sponsored by Synthetic Fixed-Income Securities, Inc. with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee, references underlying Dominion Resources securities, but no terms, board action, advisors, or structural changes are disclosed. Watch only pass-through credit and distribution continuity.
